enchantments.tooltip: Will Save +13: This item gives a +13 Resistance bonus to your Will saves.

Proof Against Poison +12: This item grants its wearer immunity to natural poisons. This item also grants a +12 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical poisons, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical poisons with a DC of less than 13 + their Fortitude save).
Lamordia: Melancholic Slot (Accessory):Apply a Lamordia augment to this item.
Lamordia: Dolorous Slot (Accessory):Apply a Lamordia augment to this item.
Mythic Ring Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
